description: Check a project for fan-outs (too many wires on a terminal), signal clashes (different signal types on one net), incomplete rows, missing signals, and terminals/parts that don't exist. Also reports supply overloads, wires outside their terminal block's clamp wire range, and sizing findings (wire too small, below the minimum size, fuse too big, missing fuse rating, voltage drop over the limit) with suggested values from the project's sizing standard. Info notes list relays, I/O, e-stops, breakers, PSUs and motors whose Codex part has no function (or incomplete terminal roles) yet, so they draw as plain blocks.
name: validate_project
title: Validate project
